summary_1line: Krishna recounts teachings on meditative Yoga, perceiving the all‑pervading Brahman within the body, and introduces a dialogue between a renunciant Brahmana and his questioning wife.

image_candidates.scene_text: A lone ascetic sits cross‑legged in a silent forest, senses restrained, meditating on the universe within his own body.
A seeker imagines the soul drawn from the body like a delicate stalk pulled from a blade of munja grass.
A learned Brahmana sits in quiet seclusion while his wife stands before him questioning his abandonment of worldly duties.
